semantics: Required direct requests for one host-authorized finite ACP conversation. Each data item carries 1 to 8192 UTF-8 bytes, cut only between Unicode scalars. Concatenate in order until end:true to obtain one JSON/1 ACP frame. There is no interleaving, replay, binary data, or independent chunk identity. The host validates the complete frame and reviewed authority before dispatch; accepting a fragment does not establish dispatch. EOF inside a frame fails the resource. Clean EOF requests process settlement only after the allowed conversation has settled. Bounds and the finite operation profile are specified by the finite-acp contract documentation.
